title: Genesis reference data (catalog/catalog.json)
description: Lists the website's choices that are data, not code: feedback categories, training presets and the photo minimum. Served by GET /api/v1/catalog. Bump version when a change would break a reader.

minPhotos.description: Fewest photos (or extracted frames) a reconstruction job accepts.

feedbackCategories.description: The kinds of feedback a user can send. id is what the API and database store.

feedbackMessage.description: Allowed message length, in characters, after trimming.

trainingPresets.description: The Model detail choices: how many Brush training iterations each runs.

defaultTrainingPreset.description: id of the preset the website selects first.
